issue.title: Make snooze tests independent of the expired 2026-08-09 wake time
issue.description: Discovered during unrelated prompt-glossary verification on 2026-08-09 at about 09:19 EDT. 'just check' escalated to the full suite and failed several bead snooze tests because shared snooze fixture constants are hard-coded to 2026-08-09T09:00:00-04:00, which is now in the past. Focused reproduction: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_bead/test_snooze_gate.py::test_bead_snooze_gate_preview_carries_the_real_snooze_note -q -vv fails with ValueError: validation: bead snooze wake time must be in the future: 2026-08-09T09:00:00-04:00 is not after 2026-08-09T13:19:36Z. The full-suite failure list also included tests/test_bead/test_snooze_lifecycle.py::test_snooze_round_trips_through_every_persistence_surface, ::test_cancel_snooze_returns_the_bead_to_ready, and ::test_plus_one_target_wakes_the_bead_with_the_preset_note. 'rg WAKE_TIME|2026-08-09T09:00|2026-08-09 tests/test_bead' shows the fixed date shared across snooze_gate_test_helpers.py, test_snooze_lifecycle.py, test_snooze_close_regression.py, test_snooze_storage.py, and test_snooze_surfaces.py. Scope: replace the fixed wall-clock dependency with a future-relative or frozen-clock fixture while preserving the intended display assertions.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction while implementing unrelated glossary preview label change in workspace 15 on 2026-08-09. After just install, just check escalated to the full non-visual suite and failed only these four bead snooze nodes: tests/test_bead/test_snooze_gate.py::test_bead_snooze_gate_preview_carries_the_real_snooze_note and tests/test_bead/test_snooze_lifecycle.py::{test_snooze_round_trips_through_every_persistence_surface,test_cancel_snooze_returns_the_bead_to_ready,test_plus_one_target_wakes_the_bead_with_the_preset_note}. Focused rerun with just test -- those four nodes reproduced 4/4 failures with ValueError: validation: bead snooze wake time must be in the future: 2026-08-09T09:00:00-04:00 is not after 2026-08-09T13:32:41Z. The prompt glossary test file passed separately (13 passed), so this blocks clean just check but is unrelated to the glossary change.

Independent flake-baseline gate impact during numbered-memory-subsection verification on 2026-08-09: just check-full passed the full pytest lane (✓ test) but failed selection-health --fail-on-new-flake, listing the same expired-wake-time snooze nodes tracked here: tests/test_bead/test_snooze_gate.py::test_bead_snooze_gate_preview_carries_the_real_snooze_note and tests/test_bead/test_snooze_lifecycle.py::{test_cancel_snooze_returns_the_bead_to_ready,test_plus_one_target_wakes_the_bead_with_the_preset_note,test_snooze_round_trips_through_every_persistence_surface}. The implementation under verification touched memory inlining and generated docs, not bead snooze behavior.

payload.entry: Already fixed by commit b73609337 (feat(glossary): render core display aliases, 2026-08-09 09:19 EDT), which added autouse frozen_snooze_clock fixtures monkeypatching sase.bead.project._now to FROZEN_NOW=2026-08-06T13:00:00Z in test_snooze_gate.py and test_snooze_lifecycle.py — before the hard-coded WAKE_TIME/UNTIL=2026-08-09T09:00:00-04:00, so the Rust core future-time check never sees real wall-clock time. test_snooze_close_regression.py already froze both sase.core.time.local_now and sase.bead.project._now (present before that commit). Verified test_snooze_storage.py and test_snooze_surfaces.py don't need freezing: test_snooze_storage.py only exercises Python-side SnoozeRecord/Issue.validate() format checks (RFC-3339 offset shape), not the Rust 'wake time must be in the future' comparison; test_snooze_surfaces.py only renders presentation/display functions and never calls BeadProject.snooze. test_snooze_gate_actions.py and test_task_gate_snooze.py use mutation_double()/mocked stores, so they never hit the real Rust validation either. Ran just install, then reproduced the exact 4 originally-failing nodes (test_snooze_gate.py::test_bead_snooze_gate_preview_carries_the_real_snooze_note, test_snooze_lifecycle.py::{test_snooze_round_trips_through_every_persistence_surface,test_cancel_snooze_returns_the_bead_to_ready,test_plus_one_target_wakes_the_bead_with_the_preset_note}) individually: all 4 pass. Ran full snooze-tagged subset (141 passed) and the entire tests/test_bead/ directory (1622 passed). just check reproduces one unrelated pre-existing failure (SASE validation / init memory --check chezmoi shim drift, tracked separately as sase-i7, which I +1'd with independent reproduction evidence). No code changes were needed for this bead; working tree remains clean.
